blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday accused the Marcos administration of using allegations involving Chinese funding, a drug bust in Laos, and a purported travel authority to build a narrative aimed at bringing her down. In a statement, she criticized the House of Representatives prosecution team for its alleged failure to establish a convincing case of an impeachable offense against her, saying “all it could offer were wacky poses that were neither entertaining nor amusing.” READ: Marcos: China ‘funding’ of VP husband’s firm poses a threat, if true “Now, we are witnessing an apparent shift in the government’s […]...
